purpose: Verify the pre-production gate: under APP_ENV=staging the platform accepts a signed fraud signal but REFUSES to contact a real phone number, so a staging demo cannot reach a customer.

mechanism.design_note: Fails LOUDLY with 403 rather than silently simulating, so a 403 in staging is positive evidence the environment is wired correctly.

live_verification.database: Supabase Postgres via eu-central-1 IPv4 pooler
steps: POST /api/enroll  (signed, action=enroll, E.164 test number) -> 200, delivery='live (Twilio)'
live_verification.interpretation: The signal was ingested and a case created, but delivery was refused before any Twilio request. No real customer could be dialled from pre-production.

unchanged_by_design.card_freeze: Still non-committing in EVERY environment: it stages a reversible pending_specialist request and returns committed:false. Human approval remains mandatory regardless of APP_ENV.
unchanged_by_design.audit_chain: Every refusal is still recorded; the guard does not bypass audit.

not_verified: The production branch of the gate (APP_ENV=production allowing a real dial) was NOT exercised, because doing so would place a genuine call to a real number. It is verified by type-check + code read only.
No Docker/CI deployment exists yet, so APP_ENV wiring per branch is documented, not automatically applied.
